near_compression_probe.scope: Four local patches of 128 actual magnetic tetrahedra each, from the exported 2,718,864-cell mesh; not a full-model or nonlinear accuracy validation.
near_compression_probe.source_entrypoint: tetra_fmm.assemble / VolumeFMM._blocks, current CUDA analytical near tensor

reproduction_recipe.selection: For each anchor choose 128 nearest tetrahedron centroids using scipy.spatial.cKDTree; sort the patch by centroid x.
reproduction_recipe.operator: Current tetra_fmm.assemble, dtype=float64, near_levels=2, correction_factor=3, source_levels=0, cache_bytes=16 MiB, index_bytes=4 MiB, batch=32; only cached near blocks are examined.
reproduction_recipe.reference: Uncompressed FP64 near-correction matvec on the local patch.
reproduction_recipe.symmetry: Copy upper triangular tensor components onto lower triangular components.
reproduction_recipe.quantization: Six components cast to FP32/FP16; scaled int16 uses per-pair max(abs(C))/32767 stored as FP32, round-to-nearest clipped to [-32767,32767].
reproduction_recipe.low_rank: Singular values of the full local 384x384 correction matrix and x-sorted subblocks; smallest k with discarded squared singular values <=1e-8 times total.

limitations: Local near-correction errors are not full-field, native constitutive residual or Maxwell errors.

conclusion.accuracy_scope: FMM near-correction coefficients and two held-out near fields only; no Maxwell or native constitutive residual certification
conclusion.performance_scope: Measured sampled patches only; compressed GPU matvec did not beat uncompressed cached FP64 BSR in aggregate. It avoided repeated analytical integration. No full-solve speedup is claimed.

fem_bem_feasibility.scope: Full magnetic TET4 corner geometry only; scalar-P1 structural counts, not a FEM/BEM field solve
fem_bem_feasibility.coordinate_welding: Exact FP64 coordinate equality; no tolerance snapping or source mesh modification
fem_bem_feasibility.interpretation: CSR is the structural graph of a scalar-P1 volume stiffness matrix, not assembled matrix values or total solve memory. Boundary faces are the exact-coordinate welded union of exported magnetic regions; an artificial outer air coupling surface must be remeshed and counted separately.

assessment.recommendation: Prototype sparse scalar-potential FEM with accelerated exterior BEM; stop treating volume near-pair compression as the main scaling route.
assessment.first_layout: Reuse magnetic TET4 mesh with direct material-surface coupling; 522922 potential plus 235652 P0 flux unknowns.
assessment.alternative_layout: Include magnets, nonlinear steel and local air/gaps in FEM; couple BEM on a smoother artificial outer surface. This requires a new mesh and unknown-count measurement.
assessment.nonlinear_method: Consistent B(H) tangents, damped Newton/continuation; coefficient-aware AMG on FEM and boundary-operator block preconditioning.
assessment.coupled_solver_status: Not implemented or run; no full GPU memory or speedup certification.
assessment.P1_accuracy_scope: Corner-only scalar P1 counts do not prove equivalence to Maxwell TET10/high-order field discretization.
assessment.platform_scope: Native Windows sparse GPU solver path is feasible through libraries such as AMGX; complete accelerated FEM-BEM integration is untested and no WSL dependency has been introduced.
